reason: Provides a configuration and status wrapper for native dsh MCP clients, supporting local stdio processes and streamable HTTP MCP endpoints with layered settings and dynamic mounting.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 配置并管理 MCP 服务器，支持本地 stdio 进程和可流式 HTTP 端点，并提供挂载状态查看。
summaries.en: Configures and manages MCP servers for dsh, supporting local stdio processes and streamable HTTP endpoints with mount-status visibility.

capabilities: Configures and mounts native MCP clients for stdio and streamable HTTP servers
Can spawn configured local MCP server executables
Can connect to configured MCP endpoint URLs and send configured headers
Synchronizes MCP server settings and reports mount status in a UI tab
